comments.text: why is this blank? Investigate the rebdering
comments.author: human-console
comments.resolutionNote: Not a rendering failure — the components were drawing correctly, in black, on a near-black background. StoryHost wrapped stories in a Box, which paints a background but provides no LocalContentColor; that comes from Surface (real screens get it via BaseScreen's Scaffold). So components inheriting content colour — AppIconButton's default tint, ScreenColumn's bare Text — fell back to black. StoryHost is now a Surface(color = Background, contentColor = OnSurface); fixed in the template and mirrored here. Re-rendered: AppIconButton enabled arrow white + disabled dimmed, ScreenColumn text legible, AppHeader title white. Story canvas sizing (small component on a full-height frame) is a separate open item.
